elements.definition: Indication of whether or not the illness or injury is work related.

elements.name: Patient's Occupational Industry
elements.definition: The occupational industry of the patient's work.

values.label: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services
Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction
Real Estate and Rental and Leasing

elements.name: Patient's Occupation
elements.definition: The occupation of the patient.

values.label: Arts, Design, Entertainment, Sports, and Media Occupations
Building and Grounds Cleaning and Maintenance Occupations
Food Preparation and Serving Related Occupations
Life, Physical, and Social Science Occupations

elements.name: Patient Activity
elements.definition: The activity the patient was involved in at the time the patient experienced the onset of symptoms or experienced an injury.

elements.name: Date/Time Last Known Well
elements.definition: The estimated date and time the patient was last known to be well or in their usual state of health. This is described or estimated by the patient, family, and/or bystanders.

elements.name: Justification for Transfer or Encounter
elements.definition: The ordering physician or medical provider diagnosis or stated reason for a hospital-to-hospital transfer, other medical transport, or Mobile Integrated Healthcare encounter.

elements.name: Reason for Interfacility Transfer/Medical Transport
elements.definition: The general categories of the reason for an interfacility transfer/medical transport.

elements.name: PSAP Call Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the phone rings (911 call to public safety answering point or other designated entity) requesting EMS services.

elements.name: Dispatch Notified Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time dispatch was notified by the 911 call taker (if a separate entity).

elements.name: Unit Notified by Dispatch Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit was notified by dispatch.

elements.name: Dispatch Acknowledged Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the dispatch was acknowledged by the EMS Unit.

elements.name: Unit En Route Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the unit responded; that is, the time the vehicle started moving.

elements.name: Unit Arrived on Scene Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived on the scene; that is, the time the vehicle stopped moving at the scene.

elements.name: Arrived at Patient Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived at the patient's side.

elements.name: Transfer of EMS Patient Care Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the patient was transferred from this EMS agency to another EMS agency for care.

elements.name: Unit Left Scene Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit left the scene (started moving).

elements.name: Arrival at Destination Landing Area Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the Air Medical vehicle arrived at the destination landing area.

elements.name: Patient Arrived at Destination Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived with the patient at the destination or transfer point.

elements.name: Destination Patient Transfer of Care Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time that patient care was transferred to the destination healthcare staff.

elements.name: Unit Back in Service Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the unit was back in service and available for response (finished with call, but not necessarily back in home location).

elements.name: Unit Canceled Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the unit was canceled.

elements.name: Unit Back at Home Location Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit was back in their service area. With agencies who utilized Agency Status Management, home location means the service area as assigned through the agency status management protocol.

elements.name: EMS Call Completed Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit completed all tasks associated with the event including transfer of the patient, and such things as cleaning and restocking.

elements.name: Unit Arrived at Staging Area Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived at a staging area, prior to arrival on scene.

elements.name: Date/Time Vital Signs Taken
elements.definition: The date/time vital signs were taken on the patient.

elements.name: Obtained Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
elements.definition: Indicates that the information which is documented was obtained prior to the documenting EMS units care.

elements.name: Cardiac Rhythm / Electrocardiography (ECG)
elements.definition: The cardiac rhythm / ECG and other electrocardiography findings of the patient as interpreted by EMS personnel.

elements.name: ECG Type
elements.definition: The type of ECG associated with the cardiac rhythm.

elements.name: Method of ECG Interpretation
elements.definition: The method of ECG interpretation.

elements.name: SBP (Systolic Blood Pressure)
elements.definition: The patient's systolic blood pressure.

elements.name: DBP (Diastolic Blood Pressure)
elements.definition: The patient's diastolic blood pressure.

elements.name: Method of Blood Pressure Measurement
elements.definition: Indication of method of blood pressure measurement.

elements.name: Mean Arterial Pressure
elements.definition: The patient's mean arterial pressure.

elements.name: Heart Rate
elements.definition: The patient's heart rate expressed as a number per minute.

elements.name: Method of Heart Rate Measurement
elements.definition: The method in which the Heart Rate was measured. Values include auscultated, palpated, electronic monitor.

elements.name: Pulse Oximetry
elements.definition: The patient's oxygen saturation.

elements.name: Pulse Rhythm
elements.definition: The clinical rhythm of the patient's pulse.

elements.name: Respiratory Rate
elements.definition: The patient's respiratory rate expressed as a number per minute.

elements.name: Respiratory Effort
elements.definition: The patient's respiratory effort.

elements.name: End Tidal Carbon Dioxide (ETCO2)
elements.definition: The numeric value of the patient's exhaled end tidal carbon dioxide (ETCO2) level measured as a unit of pressure in millimeters of mercury (mmHg), percentage or, kilopascal (kPa).

elements.name: Carbon Monoxide (CO)
elements.definition: The numeric value of the patient's carbon monoxide level measured as a percentage (%) of carboxyhemoglobin (COHb).

elements.name: Blood Glucose Level
elements.definition: The patient's blood glucose level.

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Eye
elements.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Eye opening response.

values.label: No eye movement when assessed (All Age Groups)
Opens Eyes to painful stimulation (All Age Groups)
Opens Eyes to verbal stimulation (All Age Groups)

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Verbal
elements.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Verbal response.

values.label: Inappropriate words (>2 Years); Inconsistently consolable, moaning
Confused (>2 Years); Cries but is consolable, inappropriate interactions
Oriented (>2 Years); Smiles, oriented to sounds, follows objects, interacts

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Motor
elements.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Motor response.

values.label: Obeys commands (>2Years); Appropriate response to stimulation

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Qualifier
elements.definition: Documentation of factors which make the GCS score more meaningful.

values.label: Initial GCS has legitimate values without interventions such as intubation and sedation

elements.name: Total Glasgow Coma Score
elements.definition: The patient's total Glasgow Coma Score.

elements.name: Temperature
elements.definition: The patient's body temperature in degrees Celsius/centigrade.

elements.name: Temperature Method
elements.definition: The method used to obtain the patient's body temperature.

elements.name: Level of Responsiveness (AVPU)
elements.definition: The patient's highest level of responsiveness.

elements.name: Pain Scale Score
elements.definition: The patient's indication of pain from a scale of 0-10.

elements.name: Pain Scale Type
elements.definition: The type of pain scale used.

elements.name: Stroke Scale Result
elements.definition: The findings or results of the Stroke Scale Type (eVitals.30) used to assess the patient exhibiting stroke-like symptoms.

elements.name: Stroke Scale Type
elements.definition: The type of stroke scale used.

elements.name: Reperfusion Checklist
elements.definition: The results of the patient's Reperfusion Checklist for potential Thrombolysis use.

elements.name: APGAR
elements.definition: The patient's total APGAR score (0-10).

elements.name: Revised Trauma Score
elements.definition: The patient's Revised Trauma Score.

elements.name: Stroke Scale Score
elements.definition: The stroke score value associated with the stroke scale type listed in eVitals.30.
